name: Yaskawa America — Drives & Motion Division
old_description: Yaskawa America's Drives & Motion Division produces medium-voltage switchgear (including padmounted gas-insulated switchgear) and low-voltage switchgear, as well as motor drives and controls. Designed for high-reliability power distribution in utilities, manufacturing, data center and commercial applications.
about:
Yaskawa America's Drives & Motion Division is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The division operates as a wholly owned subsidiary of Yaskawa Electric Corporation of Japan, a company founded in 1915. The U.S. corporation was created to provide automation solutions and support to customers across North, Central, and South America.

The division manufactures medium‑voltage switchgear — including pad‑mounted gas‑insulated and gas rotary‑arc models — low‑voltage switchgear, variable frequency drives, motor controllers, electric motors, and robotics automation systems. It describes itself as the world’s largest manufacturer of AC inverter drives, servo and motion control, and robotics automation systems, and has produced quality products in North America for more than 40 years.

Products serve utilities, industrial manufacturing, data centers, and commercial buildings. They are sold through direct sales, partners, representatives, dealers, and distributors. The division also supports applications in packaging, processing, and general manufacturing, offering solutions such as data‑center cooling VFDs, the iC9200 machine controller, and the iQpump605 pump drive.

Yaskawa emphasizes a quality policy that places continual improvement and customer satisfaction at the forefront, stating it has set standards competitors strive to meet. The division’s founding purpose was to bring Japanese automation expertise to the Americas, backed by a parent company with over a century of experience in productivity‑improving automation.
